description_en: You can call DescribeElasticDailyPlan to query the execution information of a daily time-based scaling plan. This operation applies only to new-version Data Warehouse Edition clusters in elastic mode
description_zh: 调用DescribeElasticDailyPlan接口查询分时弹性计划日计划执行信息。该接口仅适用于数仓版弹性模式集群版（新版）
name: DescribeElasticDailyPlan

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Data Warehouse Edition cluster.

Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html to query the IDs of all Data Warehouse Edition clusters in the destination region
parameters.help_zh:
数仓版集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口查看目标地域下所有数仓版集群的集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the scaling plan. The name must meet the following requirements:

It must be 2 to 30 characters in length.

It must consist of uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_)
parameters.help_zh:
弹性计划名称。取值说明：
长度为2~30字符。
由大写字母、小写字母、数字或下划线（_）组成
parameters.name: elastic_plan_name

parameters.help_en:
The name of the resource group.

Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/466685.html to query the name of the resource group
parameters.help_zh:
资源组名称。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/466685.html接口查看资源组名称
parameters.name: resource_pool_name

parameters.help_en: The start date of the daily scaling plan. Specify the date in the yyyy-MM-dd format
parameters.help_zh: 当天弹性计划的起始日期，格式：yyyy-MM-dd
parameters.name: elastic_daily_plan_day

parameters.help_en:
The execution status of the daily scaling plan. To query multiple statuses, separate them with commas (,). Valid values:

1: Not executed.

2: Executing.

3: Succeeded.

4: Failed
parameters.help_zh:
当天弹性计划执行状态，同时查询多个状态用半角逗号（,）分隔，取值说明：
1：未执行。
2：执行中。
3：执行成功。
4：执行失败。
parameters.name: elastic_daily_plan_status_list

ElasticDailyPlanList.description_en: A list of daily scaling plans
ElasticDailyPlanList.description_zh: 当天弹性计划的信息列表

Day.description_en: The start date of the daily scaling plan. The date is in the yyyy-MM-dd format
Day.description_zh: 当天弹性计划的起始日期，格式：yyyy-MM-dd

ElasticNodeNum.description_en:
The number of nodes for the scaling plan.

If ElasticPlanType is set to worker, this parameter is not returned or the returned value is 0.

If ElasticPlanType is set to executorcombineworker or executor, a value greater than 0 is returned
ElasticNodeNum.description_zh:
弹性计划节点数。

当ElasticPlanType为worker时，该参数不返回或返回结果为0。

当ElasticPlanType为executorcombineworker或executor时，该参数返回结果为大于0的数字

ElasticPlanType.description_en:
The resource type for the scaling plan. Valid values:

worker: scales only elastic I/O resources.

executor: scales only computing resources.

executorcombineworker (default): scales both computing resources and elastic I/O resources based on the default ratio
ElasticPlanType.description_zh:
弹性计划资源类型，取值说明：

worker：弹性IO资源单独弹性。

executor：计算资源单独弹性。

executorcombineworker（默认值）：计算，弹性IO资源按默认比例弹性

ElasticPlanWorkerSpec.description_en:
The resource specifications that are supported for scaling. Valid values:

8 Core 64 GB (default)

16 Core 64 GB

32 Core 64 GB

64 Core 128 GB

12 Core 96 GB

24 Core 96 GB

52 Core 86 GB
ElasticPlanWorkerSpec.description_zh:
弹性计划支持扩容的资源规格。取值说明：

8 Core 64 GB（默认规格）

16 Core 64 GB

32 Core 64 GB

64 Core 128 GB

12 Core 96 GB

24 Core 96 GB

52 Core 86 GB

EndTs.description_en: The actual time when the scaled-out resources were reverted. The time is in the yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss format and is displayed in UTC
EndTs.description_zh: 实际还原时间。格式：yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss（UTC时间）

PlanEndTs.description_en: The scheduled time to revert the scaled-out resources. The time is in the yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss format and is displayed in UTC
PlanEndTs.description_zh: 计划还原时间。格式：yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss（UTC时间）

PlanName.description_en: The name of the scaling plan

PlanStartTs.description_en: The scheduled scale-out time. The time is in the yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss format and is displayed in UTC
PlanStartTs.description_zh: 计划扩容时间。格式：yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss（UTC时间）

ResourcePoolName.description_en: The name of the resource group

StartTs.description_en: The actual scale-out time. The time is in the yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss format and is displayed in UTC
StartTs.description_zh: 实际扩容时间。格式：yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss（UTC时间）

Status.description_en:
The execution status of the daily scaling plan. Valid values:

1: Not executed.

2: Executing.

3: Succeeded.

4: Failed
Status.description_zh:
当天弹性计划执行状态，同时查询多个状态用半角逗号（,）分隔，取值说明：
1：未执行。
2：执行中。
3：执行成功。
4：执行失败
